title: Prospectivity Lab: Regional Adoption Signatures & Early-Indicator Playbook
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Problem: Our current model-scouting feeds and procurement triggers are largely reactive — surfaced after a major supplier shift or price shock. We lack a consistent, repeatable way to turn early public signals (benchmarks, feature rollout notes, third-party benchmarks, pilot usage patterns) into prospect-level adoption probabilities and operational triggers for Dedicated/Private sales and capacity planning.

Goal: Build a lightweight operational playbook and scoring system (Prospectivity Lab) that fuses heterogeneous signals into a per-prospect and per-region adoption probability, plus a set of action thresholds that feed sales, partnerships, and provisioning workflows. The playbook should be experimentable (A/B on thresholds), auditable (clear signal provenance), and instrumented into the market-intel dashboard for continuous improvement.
acceptance_criteria: Signal taxonomy defined and documented with 8 canonical signal types (public roadmap, pricing changes, latency benchmarks, customer-reported performance, open-source releases, region infra announcements, job postings, partner integrations)
Signal weighting prototype implemented in a spreadsheet and validated with backfill on 2 historical supplier events
Per-prospect regional score (0-100) generated for a shortlist of 120 prospects and surfaced in the market-intel dashboard
3 explicit operational triggers produced (sales outreach, reserve capacity alert, procurement pre-negotiation) with playbook runbooks
Experiment plan for thresholds defined and scheduled with analytics owners (A/B over 8 weeks)
tasks: Kickoff: align PM, analytics, field sales, and Solutions Eng on scope and deliverables
Inventory public and private signals; map owners and ingestion frequency
Design minimal signal schema (source, freshness, confidence, directional bias, weight suggestion)
Prototype scoring rules in a spreadsheet and backfill using 2024-2025 supplier event history
Embed output into market-intel dashboard; add per-prospect time-series
Define 3 operational triggers and write playbooks for each (owner, cadence, escalation)
Run 8-week threshold A/B experiment with 50/70/90 cut points and measure lead indicators
Synthesize learnings and propose handbook entry and product integration tickets
metrics: Signal coverage: % of prospects with >=3 signal types
Precision of top-decile prospect picks vs actual procurement events in historical backfill
Time-to-action: median time from threshold cross to sales touch
False positive rate for capacity reservation alerts
Experiment uplift: change in conversion or earliest-stage engagement rate during A/B
